slices.label: Adjacency-list LCA membership
slices.task: Answer consistent vertex-membership queries for one maximal independent set

results.bound: poly(Δ) · log n adjacency-list queries per membership query
results.guarantee: Consistent membership decisions for an MIS, with high probability
results.notes: Oracle answers are independently queryable for different vertices; degree dependence prevents a numeric n-only exponent.

results.bound: Δ^{O(log Δ)} · poly(log n) adjacency-list queries
results.guarantee: Consistent membership in a maximal independent set
results.sourceLocation: LCA corollary; explicit bound recalled in Ghaffari–Uitto 2019, abstract
results.notes: Intermediate improvement before sparsification and the FOCS 2022 poly(Δ log n) result.

results.bound: Δ^{O(log² Δ)} · poly(log n) time and space
results.guarantee: Consistent MIS vertex membership via adjacency probes
results.sourceLocation: Abstract; prior bound identified in Ghaffari–Uitto 2019 abstract
results.notes: Historical degree-sensitive LCA. Δ^{O(log² Δ)} poly(log n) expression is identified by the later primary Ghaffari–Uitto 2019 paper.

results.bound: Δ^{O(log log Δ)} · poly(log n) probes
results.guarantee: Consistent MIS vertex membership under graph probe access
results.notes: 2019 sparsification breaks direct neighborhood simulation degree barrier.

slices.label: Bounded-degree LCA, classic and deterministic
slices.task: Answer consistent MIS membership on bounded-degree graph
assumptions: Adjacency-list/neighbor probes; fixed maximum degree Δ
Randomized algorithms may share a seed across answers; deterministic result is stateless

results.bound: polylog(n) time per query for constant Δ
results.guarantee: Consistent vertex membership in one maximal independent set
results.sourceLocation: Abstract; Section 4, maximal independent set algorithm
results.notes: 2011 first general LCA framework for bounded-degree MIS; exponent depends on fixed Δ.

results.bound: polylog(n) time and polylog(n) working space for constant Δ
results.guarantee: Consistent MIS membership, with compact randomness and parallel queries
results.notes: Additional space and parallel consistency guarantee; not a direct time-only dominance statement.

results.guarantee: Deterministic stateless membership in an MIS
results.notes: Deterministic and stateless. Degree dependence is exponential in Δ², while n dependence is log* n; a previous poly(Δ,log* n) paraphrase was incorrect.

axis.label: Probe ladder in Δ (per answered query)
axis.scaleNote: The labeled positions are asymptotic categories; symbolic results remain in the table.

slices.label: Erdős–Rényi joint graph and MIS access
slices.task: Generate consistent access to a sampled random graph and one MIS
assumptions: The graph is sampled as G(n,q), with q the edge probability; n is the number of vertices
Joint local access generator and LCA; not worst-case arbitrary input

results.bound: polylog(n)/q work per graph-edge or MIS-membership query, with high probability
results.guarantee: Consistent access to a random graph and a maximal independent set
results.notes: Memoryless joint local access generator of graph and its MIS; for q≥1/polylog(n), per-query cost is polylog(n). This is not a fixed worst-case-input LCA.
